items.text: Brock Bowers (left knee meniscus trim) has legit chance to return Week 2 or 3 per coach. Same knee as prior PCL/bone bruise—scary.
items.why: Coach says day-to-day after trim; history concern
items.implication: Monitor practice; Mayer handcuff if out

items.text: Ladd McConkey dealing with rib injury, day-to-day per HC Jim Harbaugh. Status up in air for Week 2 vs Raiders; monitored this week.
items.why: Rib/chest injury left early W1; Harbaugh DTD
items.implication: Provisional start; Tre Harris beneficiary if out

items.text: Zay Flowers hamstring not considered serious; day-to-day. Would have returned if playoff game. MRI but abundance of caution exit W1.
items.why: Not serious per sources/coach Jesse Minter
items.implication: Likely plays W2; Bateman/Lane out boosts if sits

items.text: Patriots placing A.J. Brown on IR with high-ankle sprain; out minimum 4 games (earliest Week 6). No surgery needed.
items.why: High ankle sprain confirmed; IR move

items.text: Deebo Samuel is a top waiver wire target this week amid Stribling injury fallout.
items.why: Injury beneficiary in WAS/49ers context per FFHH

items.text: Browns placed RB Dylan Sampson on IR (knee); signed Jaleel McLaughlin. Significant time expected.
items.implication: Judkins lead but low routes; Sanders got routes

items.text: Week 2 waivers: McConkey=Tre Harris; Lane=Bateman; Kamara=Miller; Sampson=Sanders; Brown=Doubs; Stribling=Deebo. FAAB/streamers listed.
Rashee Rice career aDOT 4.9, W1 2.5 yards; only 2 targets (7% share) despite 29 routes on 33 Mahomes dropbacks (near Worthy). Needs volume for box-score payoff.
items.why: High routes but tiny aDOT and low target share

items.text: Kenneth Walker handled 29 of first 32 RB opportunities for KC, 19 routes on 33 dropbacks, 6 targets (22% share), 23-173-1 rush + 3-18-1 rec. True workhorse as expected.
items.why: Dominated opportunities and routes in debut

items.text: Travis Etienne did not dominate with Kamara (knee) out: snaps 53/26/15 Etienne/Miller/Donaldson; routes 24/5/7; opps 18/9/4.
items.implication: Miller handcuff/waiver value; Etienne not pure workhorse

items.text: Malik Nabers first game post-ACL/meniscus: 36/69 snaps (52%), 24/34 routes (71%), 9 targets (31% share), 6-69-0. Emerged healthy.
items.why: Efficient limited return with high target share

items.text: Eagles officially placed G Landon Dickerson on IR (knee); miss at least 4 games. Signed Covey/Deguara.
items.implication: OL impact on Hurts/Barkley/Saquon run game

items.text: Kenneth Walker is a full-grown man after MNF explosion; Monday Night Miracle delivery.
Quinshon Judkins only 13 routes on 30 Watson dropbacks W1 even after Sampson (knee) early exit; Raheim Sanders also 13 routes.
items.why: Low pass-game involvement despite teammate injury
